title: AI-Portfolio
description: Personal AI-powered portfolio website with interactive 3D elements and intelligent features.
longDescription: A modern portfolio website built with React, Three.js, and AI integration. Features interactive 3D animations, GSAP scroll-driven effects, theme switching, and an AI assistant for enhanced user engagement.

title: AI-WildEye
description: Web-Based Wild Animal Detection and Alert System - College Main Project.
longDescription: An AI-driven early-warning system designed to detect potential human-wildlife conflicts and issue smart alerts, demonstrating core software intelligence ahead of future hardware integration.

title: No-Due Submission Portal
description: College Mini Project - A web-based platform for student no-due clearance.
longDescription: A web-based platform that digitizes and streamlines the student no-due clearance process with secure logins, digital proof uploads, verification, and automated PDF generation.

title: AI-BrestCancer & Insurance Predictor
description: ML-based breast cancer classification and insurance purchase prediction.
longDescription: Insurance Purchase Prediction using Machine Learning. Predicted customer insurance purchases using KNN, SVM, Random Forest and Logistic Regression. Breast Cancer Histology Image Classification using CNN-based deep learning model for benign and malignant image classification.

title: AI-Job Portal
description: Django-based recruitment portal with authentication and job management.
longDescription: A full-featured job portal built with Django, featuring user authentication, job listings, application tracking, and employer dashboard for managing postings.

title: Pachoos
description: AI-E-Commerce platform with shopping cart and checkout.
longDescription: Designed an online store with shopping cart and checkout, featuring product catalog, user authentication, payment integration, and order management system.
